title: "Resources"
order: 78

This module cites no new regulation, guidance, or standard — it's industry practice,
described in this course's own words, the same handling this curriculum has always given
GAMP 5 (Good Automated Manufacturing Practice). Nothing below is quoted anywhere in the
lesson; these are general background links for further reading, not verbatim-quoted
sources. All three were checked and loading at the time this page was written, except as
noted for the one link blocked by that site's own bot protection in this environment
(see the note on it below) — confirmed instead through a public web archive snapshot.

- **[ISO 19011:2018, "Guidelines for auditing management systems"](https://www.iso.org/standard/70017.html)**
  — ISO's own public listing page for its general auditing-guidance standard: scope,
  structure, and purchase information for the standard itself (the standard's full text
  is a paid publication; this page describes it, not reproduces it). ISO's own site
  returned a bot-protection block (HTTP 403) to this session's proxy rather than a normal
  response — confirmed live and loading instead through a public web-archive snapshot
  taken recently. Worth a direct check yourself before relying on it. Useful for the
  general shape of a formal, independence-and-competency-driven audit program in a
  different industry's own words — nothing on this page is blood-establishment-specific,
  and nothing from it is cited or quoted in this lesson.

- **[AABB: Updated Quality Systems Essentials](https://www.aabb.org/standards-accreditation/standards/about-aabb-standards/updated-quality-systems-essentials)**
  — reused from `internal-audits-and-management-review` and `the-aabb-assessment-process`.
  AABB's own public page naming QSE (Quality System Essential) 8, Assessments: Internal
  and External — the drawer this whole module's program design sits under, named only,
  no Standards text quoted. Read it for the theme, not a section number.

- **[ICH Q9(R1), Quality Risk Management](https://database.ich.org/sites/default/files/ICH_Q9%28R1%29_Guideline_Step4_2023_0126_0.pdf)**
  (PDF, final version adopted 18 January 2023) — reused from `quality-risk-management`.
  Annex I is the source of Risk Ranking and Filtering, the tool this module's risk-based
  audit scheduling section calls back to directly rather than re-deriving. Read it if you
  want the actual guideline behind that one-line callback, not this lesson's paraphrase.
